# Keep internal-only options out of public TypeScript types

Options that exist for internal use must not appear in the exported types users see.

**Why:** Requested on 3 PRs by 2 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > These options should not be available in TypeScript.
  — @sheremet-va on PR #10438: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10438#pullrequestreview-4350904629
- > `hasText` and other options should be removed from the types.
  — @hi-ogawa on PR #10297: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10297#pullrequestreview-4249851584
- > Everything here is internal, so no need to add this
  — @sheremet-va on PR #9662: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9662#discussion_r2809023992
